lessons.title: What Would You Like?

items.example: Vorrei un caffè.
items.exampleMeaning: I would like a coffee.

items.example: Ho bisogno di un biglietto.
items.exampleMeaning: I need a ticket.

items.meaning: I would like a hot tea.
items.example: Vorrei un tè caldo, per favore.
items.exampleMeaning: I would like a hot tea, please.

items.example: Dove posso trovare il check-in?
items.exampleMeaning: Where can I find the check-in?

items.example: A che ora arriva il volo da Roma?
items.exampleMeaning: What time does the flight from Rome arrive?

items.example: Posso avere il menu, per favore?
items.exampleMeaning: Can I have the menu, please?

lessons.tip: Use 'vorrei' to express what you want politely. It is a common way to make requests in Italian.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Hi! What would you like?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I would like a ticket, please.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Where can I find the check-in?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Is it near here?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Yes, it is near.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: A che ora parte il volo?
dialogue.meaning: What time does the flight leave?

scenario.partnerRole: You are a ticket agent at the airport.
scenario.learnerRole: You are a traveler looking to buy a ticket.
scenario.brief: Ask the traveler what they would like and help them with questions about their flight.
scenario.goal: You need to ask for a ticket and find out about your flight.

lessons.title: Travel Documents

items.example: Dove hai messo il passaporto?
items.exampleMeaning: Where did you put the passport?

items.example: Ho bisogno della carta d'imbarco.
items.exampleMeaning: I need the boarding pass.

items.example: Devo controllare il mio passaporto.
items.exampleMeaning: I need to check my passport.

items.example: Il passaporto è qui, è tutto in ordine.
items.exampleMeaning: The passport is here, everything is in order.

items.example: Dove si trova il gate?
items.exampleMeaning: Where is the gate?

items.example: Posso vedere la carta d'imbarco?
items.exampleMeaning: Can I see the boarding pass?

lessons.tip: Use 'il passaporto' and 'la carta d'imbarco' to refer to important travel documents. These are necessary for flights.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Do you have the passport?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, here is the passport.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Dove si trova la carta d'imbarco?
dialogue.meaning: Where is the boarding pass?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Can I see the boarding pass?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Everything is in order, perfect!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I need to check my passport.

scenario.partnerRole: You are a security agent at the airport.
scenario.learnerRole: You are a traveler going through security.
scenario.brief: Ask the traveler for their documents and check if everything is in order.
scenario.goal: You need to show your passport and boarding pass.

lessons.title: Asking Questions

items.example: Che tipo di volo hai prenotato?
items.exampleMeaning: What type of flight did you book?

items.example: Qual è il tuo nome completo?
items.exampleMeaning: What is your full name?

items.example: Da dove parti per Roma?
items.exampleMeaning: Where are you departing from for Rome?

items.example: Quando arrivi a Milano?
items.exampleMeaning: When do you arrive in Milan?

items.example: Hai bisogno di aiuto con i bagagli?
items.exampleMeaning: Do you need help with the luggage?

items.example: Perché sei in Italia in vacanza?
items.exampleMeaning: Why are you in Italy on vacation?

lessons.tip: Questions in Italian often start with words like 'che', 'qual', or 'da dove'. Practice forming questions to communicate better.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Che tipo di volo hai prenotato?
dialogue.meaning: What type of flight did you book?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I booked a direct flight.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: What is your name?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: My name is Alex.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Where are you departing from?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I am departing from London.

scenario.learnerRole: You are a passenger asking questions about your flight.
scenario.brief: Ask the passenger questions about their flight details and help them with information.
scenario.goal: You need to ask questions to understand your flight better.

lessons.title: Making Requests

items.example: Mi può aiutare con il bagaglio?
items.exampleMeaning: Can you help me with the luggage?

items.example: Vorrei sapere dove è il gate.
items.exampleMeaning: I would like to know where the gate is.

items.example: Può dirmi a che ora parte il volo?
items.exampleMeaning: Can you tell me what time the flight leaves?

items.example: Mi scusi, per favore, dove si trova il bagno?
items.exampleMeaning: Excuse me, please, where is the bathroom?

items.example: C'è un problema con il mio biglietto.
items.exampleMeaning: There is a problem with my ticket.

items.example: Posso chiedere dove è il check-in?
items.exampleMeaning: Can I ask where the check-in is?

lessons.tip: When asking for help, start with 'mi può aiutare?' or 'mi scusi'. This is polite and shows respect.

dialogue.meaning: Excuse me, please, where is the bathroom?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: The bathroom is to the right.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Can you help me?

dialogue.meaning: I would like to know where the gate is.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Può dirmi a che ora parte il volo?
dialogue.meaning: Can you tell me what time the flight leaves?
